title: Refresher Road Safety Training for Drivers of Heavy Vehicles and Buses
what_it_is: Refresher Road Safety Training for Drivers of Heavy Vehicles and Buses

sections.label: Driver road safety training
sections.summary: Training, refresher courses and corrective education exist for heavy vehicle and bus drivers, including vocational licence modules and operator-run courses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport what training, continuous training and refresher courses or programmes are in place to ensure that drivers of heavy vehicles and buses stay updated on road safety and take extra precautions to prevent accidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This applies for all motorists, including drivers of heavy vehicles and buses, as part of the process of obtaining their Class 4/4A or 5 driving licence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In addition, the driving schools and the Automobile Association of Singapore offer courses that drivers can sign up for, such as courses on defensive driving and crash prevention.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Drivers who have accumulated a certain number of demerit points are also encouraged to undertake corrective education through the Safe Driving Course or Driver Improvement Points System retraining courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The mandatory Bus Driver’s Vocational Licence course for private bus drivers will reinforce key road safety aspects covered under the driving licence syllabus.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Public bus captains are required to pass a module on Safe Driving Techniques in order to obtain their Omnibus Driver’s Vocational Licence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Bus captains continue their training even after they are deployed, through avenues such as operator-run refresher courses or regular safety briefings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Bus captains who exhibit high-risk driving behaviour are identified and promptly sent for corrective training.

sections.label: Psychological support for transport workers
sections.summary: Public transport workers are referred to medical professionals for psychological support and counselling as necessary, particularly those who experienced trauma such as serious accidents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: For public transport workers, they will also be referred to medical professionals for psychological support and counselling as necessary, particularly those who may have experienced trauma, such as serious accidents, during the course of their work.
